Holstein, back under the Danish crown

correction.text: the territory of the provisional government: Holstein and the south of Schleswig, as the Cliopatria shape of 1848-1852 draws it

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for the rebels' territory, 1848-1851: Cliopatria's 'Duchy of Holstein' shape (87 cells, 20,119 km2) is used as its outline: Holstein plus the south of Schleswig. The page says only that the rebels 'drew their base from Holstein, which was ethnically German, and from the Low German-speaking South of Schleswig'; the front moved with the war (Prussian victory at Schleswig 23 April 1848, the Armistice of Malmö 26 August 1848, Danish victories at Fredericia 6 July 1849 and Idstedt 24-25 July 1850), which no page opened maps year by year. Unverified: page budget.

region.text: Holstein and the south of Schleswig in revolt

ledger.note: March 1848: Schleswig-Holstein rises against Denmark and forms a provisional government. 'In March 1848, the Low German-speaking population of Schleswig, Holstein, and Lauenburg rebelled', 'created a provisional government and army'; Prince Frederick of Noer's force took the fortress of Rendsburg, which held the duchies' main armoury, and secured the garrison's allegiance (infobox start 24 March 1848). The page does not name the seat.
March 1848: Holstein passes to the rebels. The rebels 'drew their base from Holstein, which was ethnically German'.

1848: the south of Schleswig joins the rising. The rebels' base included 'the Low German-speaking South of Schleswig'; on 12 April 1848 the German Confederation 'recognizes the provisional government of Schleswig and commissions Prussia to enforce its decrees'.

April 1848: Prussian troops cross the Dannevirke into Schleswig. '19 April: Prussian troops cross the Dannevirke into Schleswig'; the Danes won at Bov on 9 April 1848, the Prussians at Schleswig on 23 April.

April 1851: the rebel army is disbanded. 'On 1 April 1851, the Schleswig-Holstein army was disbanded'; the war ended 'status quo ante bellum' (Danish victory at Idstedt, 24-25 July 1850; Treaty of Berlin, 2 July 1850).

region.text: Holstein and the south of Schleswig

ledger.note: April 1851: the provisional government's rule ends with the disbanding of its army; Holstein and Schleswig return to the Danish crown (the London Protocol of 8 May 1852 confirms the personal union). Cliopatria keeps the shape to 1852.

wars.name: First Schleswig War

zones.text: Schleswig, where the fighting was (Bov, Schleswig, Fredericia, Idstedt)

wars.outcome: A Danish victory, 'status quo ante bellum': the Treaty of Berlin of 2 July 1850 between Prussia and Denmark, Danish victory at Idstedt on 24-25 July 1850, the rebel army disbanded on 1 April 1851, and the London Protocol of 8 May 1852 kept the duchies joined to Denmark by personal union.
wars.note: The Duchy of Holstein page says only that Denmark 'defended its rule over Holstein in the First Schleswig War of 1848-51 against the Kingdom of Prussia'.

certainty.note: A war-time front, not a boundary; the Cliopatria shape is used as drawn.

notes:
Written for batch eu-20-l (same two pages as duchy-of-holstein; a rebel state Cliopatria lacks). Its outline is the Cliopatria 'Duchy of Holstein' shape of 1848-1852 (see the duchy-of-holstein dossier), which is the rebel territory, not the duchy. NOT SETTLED: the seat of the provisional government (the First Schleswig War page does not name it: capitals left empty); the front year by year; the end date (army disbanded 1 April 1851; Cliopatria and the London Protocol, 8 May 1852, keep it to 1852); Lauenburg ('also rebelled') is not drawn. The duchy-of-schleswig dossier (batch eu-09-x) should carry loss/gain events for the south of Schleswig against this slug. Name and slug are mine: the page calls it 'a provisional government'.
